title: Changing the customer clears the Authorizer; changing only the contact does not
custom_preconds: Two customers (A and B), each with a contact flagged "Approves Work"; A also has a second, unflagged contact and B an unflagged one An estimate WO for customer A with one line, its primary contact set to A's flagged contact, and its Authorizer set to that same contact — all seeded via API

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the work order's Lines tab and read the customer card's Authorizer row
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Authorizer row shows customer A's flagged (“Approves Work”) contact, the one seeded.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Change Customer, leave the Customer on A, switch the Contact to A's other contact, submit, and reload
custom_steps_separated.expected: The primary Contact is now A's other contact, but the Authorizer row still shows the original flagged contact — changing only the contact does not clear the Authorizer.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Change Customer again, switch the Customer from A to B, submit, and reload
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Authorizer row reads “None” — changing the work order's customer cleared the Authorizer.
The picker offers only customer B's contacts flagged “Approves Work”, plus a “No authorizer” row that clears the selection; none of A's contacts and none of B's unflagged contacts appear.

The Authorizer saves against customer B and the row shows that contact's full name.

---

Source: the picker rules — only contacts flagged “Approves Work” are offered, “None” shows when empty, and the “No authorizer” option clears it — are as per epic SV-8218 and the Invoice UI Refresh specification (Confluence page 755990532), Story 3, requirements S3-R5 and S3-R6, read on 10 September 2026.

That changing the work order's customer clears the Authorizer, and changing only the contact does not, is NOT stated in that specification (Story 3 is silent) and is Manually added (QA lead, 2026-09-10) from product knowledge.
